subject: MSA/Order Form: DPA sequencing & SCCs fallback orchestration
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acmecorp.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: Colin Barr <colin.barr@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redline + SCCs fallback — sequencing ask

Laura — thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is our consolidated redline (Acme_DPA_redline_20261018.docx) and an SCCs fallback mapping we worked up to cover non-standard transfer routes. High level asks: 

- Can Redwood confirm whether the Order Form can include a narrow transfer impact addendum rather than wholesale localized data residency obligations? We want to avoid a multi-addendum approach if Redwood has a documented fallback sequence.
- We flagged two clauses for potential carveouts (Section 4.2 controller/processor roles & Annex B routing). See comments in the doc.
- Please confirm evidence we can provide for your SCCs/processor-role mapping; we can run a short ops workshop if helpful.

Attached: Acme_DPA_redline_20261018.docx (redlines) | SCCs-fallback-matrix_20261018.xlsx (routing + fallback matrix)

Thanks — happy to sync with Legal/Procurement as needed.

Best,
Sophie Martin
Head of Procurement — AcmeCorp
Sophie.Martin@acmecorp.com

---
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redline + SCCs fallback — sequencing ask

Thanks Sophie — got the attachments and the matrix. Quick answers inline:

- Yes, we can surface a transfer-impact addendum on the Order Form that defines a prioritized routing + fallback policy instead of separate localized addenda. That is our recommended path for customers who need predictable behavior without per-country addenda.
- Section 4.2 carveouts look reasonable; we'll need Legal to sign off on the exact language.
- For SCCs evidence: the SCCs mapping + a short technical appendix (hosting regions, KMS boundary, subprocessor list) is usually sufficient. We can provide a one-hour ops walkthrough and the exported subprocessor manifest.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal redline review by Redwood Legal (I will loop them in) — target EOD Wed 21 Oct.
2) Ops workshop (30–60m) with Acme engineering to validate fallback behavior — propose Thu 22 Oct.
3) If we converge, prepare an Order Form addendum (transfer-impact policy) and a short appendix for SCCs evidence.

Ben/Jonas — can you confirm availability for the ops workshop on Thu 22 Oct (30–60m) and whether we can commit to producing the subprocessor manifest and KMS boundary doc before the call?

Laura
Director, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: DPA redline + SCCs fallback — sequencing ask

Laura — available Thu 22 Oct 10:00–11:00 PT. I can host the call and bring the platform engineer (Vivek) for the routing details. We can produce the subprocessor manifest and a high-level KMS boundary doc by EOD Wed 21 Oct.

A couple of commercial checks: if Acme needs guaranteed regional-only processing (no fallback outside EU/UK, for example) that will push them into a Dedicated or Private deployment conversation. We should confirm that fallback policy they want is actually acceptable to them — Sophie, can you confirm tolerance for the fallback sequence in the matrix? If they need absolute region lock we should surface pricing/commitment implications before we draft the addendum.

Ben
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Laura/Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming: Acme is OK with the prioritized fallback approach in the matrix so long as the Order Form addendum records the sequence and the conditions that would trigger a region fallback (capacity outage, emergency maintenance). We are not asking for an absolute lock today.

We accept the ops workshop on Thu 22 Oct 10:00 PT. Colin (cc) will join from Legal. Please send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (one page) summarizing the fallback triggers and the evidence we will see.

I also attached a short procurement checklist (inline in the Doc) — we expect the final Order Form addendum + signed DPA clean copy and a DocuSign link for signature after the workshop.

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.
Sophie
Head of Procurement — AcmeCorp
